castModel.rounding: IEEE-754 binary16, bfloat16 and binary32, round to nearest, ties to even, from the exact source value
castModel.floatToInteger: truncate toward zero; non-finite or out-of-range inputs excluded as undefined
castModel.nan: any NaN when the types differ
castModel.toBool: nonzero, float32, bfloat16 and complex64 by bits
castModel.complex: real part to scalars, zero imaginary from scalars
